evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Strassburg: Argentina, Argentoratum
terms.comment: Morgan–Owens gives it as feminine, Argentorātus, and finds it much more common than Argentīna; the long ā is its marking. Not in Lewis & Short, so labelled from Graesse. A town takes no preposition: Argentorātum (to), Argentorātī (in, at), Argentorātō (from).
